prompt: Build a pay-per-call joke API that charges 0.005 USDC per request using x402

spec.name: JokePayPerCall
spec.description: A pay-per-call joke API that charges 0.005 USDC per request using the x402 protocol on Algorand

local_state.name: balance
local_state.description: User's prepaid credit balance in microUSDC

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initialize the joke service with a set price

methods.name: record_payment
methods.description: Records a USDC payment to the user's local state balance

methods.name: get_service_stats
methods.description: Returns the total number of jokes served globally

methods.name: withdraw
methods.description: Allows the owner to withdraw accumulated USDC

ui_requirements: Button to trigger x402 payment flow
Display area for the 'paid' joke content
Owner dashboard to view total jokes served and withdraw funds
business_logic: Only the contract owner can withdraw funds
Payments must be recorded before API access is granted by the x402 middleware
Price is defined in micro-units (1 USDC = 1,000,000 units, so 0.005 = 5,000)

events.clear_teal:
#pragma version 11
#pragma typetrack false

// @algorandfoundation/algorand-typescript/base-contract.d.ts::BaseContract.clearStateProgram() -> uint64:
main:
    pushint 1 // 1
    return

methods.name: record_payment
methods.desc:
record_payment is called by the x402 facilitator or service owner 
after a USDC transfer has been verified on-chain.

methods.name: increment_usage
methods.desc:
increment_usage is called by the API middleware when a joke is successfully served.
This deducts the price from the user's local balance.

methods.name: withdraw
methods.desc:
Allows the owner to withdraw accumulated USDC from the contract account.
Note: This assumes the contract holds the USDC Asset.
